scores.interpretation: Mode B finding: AT&T does disclose the relationship (PASS for AT&T side). Verizon — for whom ASTS claims a 'definitive commercial agreement' signed Oct 8, 2025 with service starting 2026 — has ZERO mentions of SpaceMobile in EDGAR full-text searches. Per heuristic 7, this is meaningful only if material. The deal is a forward-looking direct-to-cellular agreement for nationwide coverage — material to Verizon's product roadmap. Absence in Verizon's own SEC filings (no 10-Q, no 8-K reference) is a MOD finding (could reflect both that Verizon CIK lookup is off or that it's not yet material enough). Pure check on CIK 0000732712 yielded zero — flag as MOD with note re: counterparty CIK verification.
